name: D2C competitor teardown analyst
summary: Reverse engineers a D2C brand's marketing from public evidence (catalogue, offers, pixels and apps, Meta and Google ads, search demand, positioning history) and hands each of the owner's agents a cited brief on what to copy and where to win.

changelog.note: New D2C teardown kit: public evidence collector (catalogue, offers, Shopify apps and pixels, Google Ads Transparency, autocomplete, YouTube, Wayback), Meta Ad Library sampling through the official connector, a report checker, branded rendering and per-agent briefs.
